intro: Between 2026-04-14 and 2026-09-30, ZCyberNews published 11 articles tagged agentic-ai. Coverage spans healthcare, technology, cross-sector, enterprise, and financial services, with incidents reported globally and specifically in Australia and Israel. The severity mix comprises eight high-severity items and one informational item. Among the vulnerabilities tracked is CVE-2026-6389, which carries a CVSS score of 8.8. This archive collects reporting on agentic AI across that period, organised by the sectors and regions affected.
